ARC-01.evidence: Hand-written SQL per feature on PostgreSQL (desk/store.py:9-83) using UNIQUE (org_id, kind, key, version) (migrations/001_init.sql:19) and failed_lookups_org_normalised index (001_init.sql:30); no caching.

ARC-02.evidence: Forward-only migration files applied by deskctl.py migrate (deskctl.py:14-21); no down steps, no online strategy, no migration tests beyond fresh-schema setup (tests/conftest.py:15-16).

ARC-03.evidence: Web instances keep no local state and several can run behind a load balancer (docs/operations.md:3, desk/app.py:15-18); caveat: run one drafting worker, two never tried (docs/operations.md:3). No manifests or tests exercise scale-out.

ARC-04.evidence: jobs table with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED claim and up to three attempts, then failed with last_error (desk/store.py:73-83, desk/drafter.py:67-77); no back-off between job attempts, no idempotency key, no view of jobs.

ARC-05.evidence: Every query scoped by org_id (desk/store.py:1-83) with isolation tests (tests/test_isolation.py:5-25) and per-organisation quotas of 500 rules and 1,000 answers (desk/checks.py:7,18-19); no noisy-neighbour detection or request rate limits. Incident: June 2026, one organisation with 2,000 rules made /ask slow for everyone (docs/operations.md:5, desk/checks.py:7).

ARC-06.evidence: The only limit was discovered in the June 2026 incident; 'No other limit has been measured' (docs/operations.md:5). No performance suite.

ARC-07.evidence: An external uptime monitor calls /health every minute; 'There are no other metrics or alerts' (docs/operations.md:7, desk/app.py:153-155).

ARC-08.evidence: Model calls have a 20-second timeout and three attempts with back-off (desk/drafter.py:26-36); answering and routing do not use the model and keep working when it is down (docs/operations.md:11, desk/app.py:39-48). No circuit breakers, no DB timeouts, no fallback tests.

ai.evidence: Timeouts and retries on model calls (desk/drafter.py:26-36); failure confined to drafting jobs (desk/drafter.py:76-77, docs/operations.md:11); no breaker or tested fallback.
